acpi_reference_method: Captured RTMR0 digests from the authenticated GCP TDX boot with the recorded machine shape. ACPI tables are not independently reconstructed offline.
scope: Qualified base OS boot. Additional disks or changed launch settings require comparison against these references; they are not qualified by this single-disk capture.

verifiers.sigstore: GitHub CLI 2.83.0; exact repository/workflow/source ref/source commit/workflow commit; GitHub-hosted runner
verifiers.google: OpenSSL certificate and RSA-PSS-SHA256 verification against pinned Google GCE TCB root

exported_uki_packaging_issue.reason: package-image invokes objcopy --dump-section without an output file, rewriting its input; the boot disk is unaffected
